# Welcome and Thank You for the Honor to Serve Pleasanton!
On November 5, 2024, I was deeply humbled to be elected as your Mayor. Thank you for your trust and support.
Reflecting on my time as your Councilmember since 2020 and now as your Mayor, I am profoundly grateful for the opportunity to serve this exceptional community. Together, we have prioritized public safety, fiscal responsibility, transparent governance, and clean water solutions—all of which are foundational to the thriving quality of life we cherish in Pleasanton.
I encourage you to get involved in shaping Pleasanton’s future! Whether it’s through sharing your voice, serving on a city committee, or supporting our community through local organizations, your participation makes a difference. Together, we can fold diverse perspectives into common-sense solutions for a better Pleasanton.
Here are just a few ways to engage:
- City Committee & Commissions: Applications open in Spring & Fall
- Pleasanton Community of Character Collaborative
- Pleasanton Make a Difference
- Just Serve
- Tri-Valley Nonprofit Alliance
My commitment to serving and listening to you continues. If you’d like to host an event, volunteer, or share ideas, please reach out—I’m eager to listen and collaborate.
Please check out my newsletters and communication:
- 50 Day Newsletter HERE
- 100 Day Newsletter HERE
- 1st Year Newsletter HERE
- 2026 State of the City HERE
- And if you'd like to learn more about some of my core beliefs, please read my prior speeches here;
  - 'This I Believe' HERE
  - Responding to the Little Fire HERE
  - Memorial Day Remarks HERE
  - America's 250th Birthday / Fourth of July HERE
# Looking at 2026!
On May 4, 2026, I announced my candidacy for reelection as your Mayor, asking your support for a second term. Please read my press release HERE. We'd love your support and I ask for your vote this November 3, 2026!
Again, thank you, Pleasanton, for the privilege of serving as your Mayor. Together, we are working towards a vibrant and inclusive future for our city.
Warm regards,
Jack Balch, Mayor of Pleasanton
